properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Milford Haven / Pembroke Refinery
properties.operationalAction: Major hydrocarbon storage & refining facility. Maintain 1.2km upwind clearance during industrial alarms.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Barry Docks Chemical Complex
properties.operationalAction: Silicone & specialty chemical installations. Shelter indoors or evacuate cross-wind if vapour release occurs.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Baglan Bay / Port Talbot Industrial Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Heavy industrial & energy storage corridor adjacent to M4. Divert inland during hazmat incidents.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Deeside / Shotton Industrial & Gas Terminal
properties.operationalAction: Combined cycle power & chemical manufacturing zone on Dee estuary.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Wrexham Industrial Estate Hazmat Sector
properties.operationalAction: Industrial chemical & manufacturing storage buffer. Maintain perimeter clearance.

properties.name: Llyn Peris / A4086 Hydrological & Cordon Buffer
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn / Beddgelert Flood Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth Crossing)
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Taff & Rhondda Confluence Flood Corridor (Pontypridd)
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Nant Ffrancon & Ogwen Valley Cellular Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass & Pen-y-Pass Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin Interior Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains & Milltir Cerrig Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley & Elenydd Wilderness Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Western Bannau Brycheiniog / Black Mountain Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe High-Power Broadcast & Telecom Hub (300m Mast)
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | High RF Density Contour
properties.operationalAction: Strong local RF field; potential front-end overload on unshielded handheld receivers within 850m.

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc Strategic Broadcast & Microwave Mast
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Broadcast & Radar Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Strategic Broadcast Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Halkyn Mountain & Clwydian Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Gwynedd Granite & Slate Belt
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Wales Coalfield & Taff Gorge
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.name: SSSI: Eryri / Yr Wyddfa & Cwm Idwal National Nature Reserve
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: High-Conservation SSSI Zone. No harvesting, uprooting, or disturbance permitted.

properties.name: SSSI: Cors Caron Raised Bog National Nature Reserve (Tregaron)
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected peatland habitat. Keep strictly to designated raised boardwalks.

properties.name: SSSI: Gower Coast (Rhossili to Port Eynon)
properties.primaryMetric: Statutory Coastal SSSI | Wildlife & Countryside Act 1981
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected maritime cliff flora and seabird nesting habitat.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Coed y Brenin & Ganllwyd Oakwoods
properties.primaryMetric: NRW Ancient Semi-Natural Woodland | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: Legal personal-use above-ground flora only (wild garlic, nettles, bilberries, hazelnuts). No uprooting. DO NOT harvest wild fungi/mushrooms.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Gwydyr Forest & Betws-y-Coed Valley
properties.primaryMetric: Mixed Broadleaf/Conifer Canopy | Thermal Shelter & Flora
properties.operationalAction: Dense canopy windbreak & fallen deadwood fuel. Personal above-ground foliage/berries only; strictly exclude wild mushrooms.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Lower Elan & Wye Valley Broadleaf
properties.primaryMetric: Sessile Oak & Hazel Coppice | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: High seasonal mast (hazelnuts, blackberries, sorrel). Above-ground personal harvest only; zero wild fungi.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Wentwood & Wye Gorge Broadleaf
properties.primaryMetric: Largest Ancient Woodland in South Wales | Broadleaf Canopy
properties.operationalAction: Rich spring wild garlic, elderflower/elderberry, and hazel. Above-ground personal use only; exclude wild fungi.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Carneddau & Glyderau Massif
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Mountain & Moorland
properties.operationalAction: Legal right of foot access across uncultivated upland terrain for high-contour ridge bypasses.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Central Bannau Brycheiniog (Pen y Fan)
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Old Red Sandstone Escarpment
properties.operationalAction: Legal off-trail upland movement zone above valley flood corridors.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Mynydd Preseli Ridge (Pembrokeshire)
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | West Wales Upland Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Open moorland ridge corridor with long-range VHF line-of-sight.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Milford Haven / Pembroke Refinery
properties.operationalAction: Major hydrocarbon storage & refining facility. Maintain 1.2km upwind clearance during industrial alarms.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Barry Docks Chemical Complex
properties.operationalAction: Silicone & specialty chemical installations. Shelter indoors or evacuate cross-wind if vapour release occurs.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Baglan Bay / Port Talbot Industrial Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Heavy industrial & energy storage corridor adjacent to M4. Divert inland during hazmat incidents.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Deeside / Shotton Industrial & Gas Terminal
properties.operationalAction: Combined cycle power & chemical manufacturing zone on Dee estuary.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Wrexham Industrial Estate Hazmat Sector
properties.operationalAction: Industrial chemical & manufacturing storage buffer. Maintain perimeter clearance.

properties.name: Llyn Peris / A4086 Hydrological & Cordon Buffer
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn / Beddgelert Flood Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth Crossing)
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Taff & Rhondda Confluence Flood Corridor (Pontypridd)
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Nant Ffrancon & Ogwen Valley Cellular Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass & Pen-y-Pass Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin Interior Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains & Milltir Cerrig Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley & Elenydd Wilderness Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Western Bannau Brycheiniog / Black Mountain Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe High-Power Broadcast & Telecom Hub (300m Mast)
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | High RF Density Contour
properties.operationalAction: Strong local RF field; potential front-end overload on unshielded handheld receivers within 850m.

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc Strategic Broadcast & Microwave Mast
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Broadcast & Radar Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Strategic Broadcast Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Halkyn Mountain & Clwydian Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Gwynedd Granite & Slate Belt
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Wales Coalfield & Taff Gorge
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.name: SSSI: Eryri / Yr Wyddfa & Cwm Idwal National Nature Reserve
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: High-Conservation SSSI Zone. No harvesting, uprooting, or disturbance permitted.

properties.name: SSSI: Cors Caron Raised Bog National Nature Reserve (Tregaron)
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected peatland habitat. Keep strictly to designated raised boardwalks.

properties.name: SSSI: Gower Coast (Rhossili to Port Eynon)
properties.primaryMetric: Statutory Coastal SSSI | Wildlife & Countryside Act 1981
properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected maritime cliff flora and seabird nesting habitat.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Coed y Brenin & Ganllwyd Oakwoods
properties.primaryMetric: NRW Ancient Semi-Natural Woodland | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: Legal personal-use above-ground flora only (wild garlic, nettles, bilberries, hazelnuts). No uprooting. DO NOT harvest wild fungi/mushrooms.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Gwydyr Forest & Betws-y-Coed Valley
properties.primaryMetric: Mixed Broadleaf/Conifer Canopy | Thermal Shelter & Flora
properties.operationalAction: Dense canopy windbreak & fallen deadwood fuel. Personal above-ground foliage/berries only; strictly exclude wild mushrooms.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Lower Elan & Wye Valley Broadleaf
properties.primaryMetric: Sessile Oak & Hazel Coppice | Theft Act 1968 Compliant
properties.operationalAction: High seasonal mast (hazelnuts, blackberries, sorrel). Above-ground personal harvest only; zero wild fungi.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Wentwood & Wye Gorge Broadleaf
properties.primaryMetric: Largest Ancient Woodland in South Wales | Broadleaf Canopy
properties.operationalAction: Rich spring wild garlic, elderflower/elderberry, and hazel. Above-ground personal use only; exclude wild fungi.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Carneddau & Glyderau Massif
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Mountain & Moorland
properties.operationalAction: Legal right of foot access across uncultivated upland terrain for high-contour ridge bypasses.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Central Bannau Brycheiniog (Pen y Fan)
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | Old Red Sandstone Escarpment
properties.operationalAction: Legal off-trail upland movement zone above valley flood corridors.

properties.name: CRoW Open Access Land: Mynydd Preseli Ridge (Pembrokeshire)
properties.primaryMetric: CRoW Act 2000 Statutory Access | West Wales Upland Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Open moorland ridge corridor with long-range VHF line-of-sight.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Milford Haven / Pembroke Refinery
properties.operationalAction: Major hydrocarbon storage & refining facility. Maintain 1.2km upwind clearance during industrial alarms.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Barry Docks Chemical Complex
properties.operationalAction: Silicone & specialty chemical installations. Shelter indoors or evacuate cross-wind if vapour release occurs.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Baglan Bay / Port Talbot Industrial Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Heavy industrial & energy storage corridor adjacent to M4. Divert inland during hazmat incidents.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Deeside / Shotton Industrial & Gas Terminal
properties.operationalAction: Combined cycle power & chemical manufacturing zone on Dee estuary.

properties.name: HSE COMAH Zone: Wrexham Industrial Estate Hazmat Sector
properties.operationalAction: Industrial chemical & manufacturing storage buffer. Maintain perimeter clearance.

properties.name: Llyn Peris / A4086 Hydrological & Cordon Buffer
properties.operationalAction: High-voltage surge & reservoir tailrace overflow corridor. Divert above 150m contour via Waunfawr.

properties.name: Conwy Valley Floodplain (Llanrwst to Trefriw)
properties.operationalAction: B5106 & valley floor submerge rapidly during Carneddau storms. Use elevated eastern A470.

properties.name: Afon Glaslyn / Beddgelert Flood Corridor
properties.operationalAction: Narrow gorge bottleneck on A498. Prone to flash river overtopping and rockfall.

properties.name: Afon Dyfi Floodplain (Machynlleth Crossing)
properties.operationalAction: A487 bridge approaches flood during combined high tide and mountain runoff.

properties.name: Taff & Rhondda Confluence Flood Corridor (Pontypridd)
properties.operationalAction: Steep valley walls funnel high-velocity water onto A470/A4058 valley floor.

properties.name: Lower Tywi Floodplain (Llandeilo to Carmarthen)
properties.operationalAction: Extensive agricultural & road plain inundation. Maintain route along elevated A40 ridge.

properties.name: Nant Ffrancon & Ogwen Valley Cellular Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Deep glaciated trough blocks mast line-of-sight. Use 2m VHF 145.500 MHz or GB3AR (145.725 MHz).

properties.name: Llanberis Pass & Pen-y-Pass Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero mobile data or 999 voice inside pass. Climb above 450m ridge or relay via Capel Curig.

properties.name: Rhinogydd & Coed y Brenin Interior Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Persistent upland shadow across Ardudwy range. Pre-cache offline route before entering.

properties.name: Berwyn Mountains & Milltir Cerrig Signal Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Zero cellular coverage along B4391 pass. Maintain BLE stand-off mesh with convoy.

properties.name: Elan Valley & Elenydd Wilderness Dead Zone
properties.operationalAction: Largest continuous cellular shadow in Mid Wales. Rely on offline .pmtiles & VHF simplex.

properties.name: Western Bannau Brycheiniog / Black Mountain Shadow
properties.operationalAction: Steep escarpment blocks South Wales masts. Gain northern ridge crest for line-of-sight.

properties.name: Wenvoe High-Power Broadcast & Telecom Hub (300m Mast)
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 500 kW UHF / VHF | High RF Density Contour
properties.operationalAction: Strong local RF field; potential front-end overload on unshielded handheld receivers within 850m.

properties.name: Moel-y-Parc Strategic Broadcast & Microwave Mast
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Clwydian Range Line-of-Sight Hub
properties.operationalAction: Dominant North-East Wales RF beacon. Elevated ground provides optimal 2m/70cm simplex range.

properties.name: Blaenplwyf Coastal Broadcast & Radar Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Cardigan Bay Maritime & Broadcast Hub
properties.operationalAction: Primary Mid-Wales coastal transmitter. Expect elevated RF noise floor near perimeter.

properties.name: Llanddona Anglesey Strategic Broadcast Station
properties.primaryMetric: ERP: 100 kW | Co-located with GB3LL 2m Repeater
properties.operationalAction: Covers Menai Strait, Eryri north coast, and Irish Sea approaches.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Halkyn Mountain & Clwydian Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: >30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Carboniferous limestone karst releases elevated radon gas. Ventilate basements, caves, or subterranean shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: Gwynedd Granite & Slate Belt
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Fractured metamorphic slate & granite bedrock. Avoid prolonged occupancy in unventilated mine adits or cellars.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Pembrokeshire & Gower Limestone
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Coastal limestone fault zone. Ensure active cross-ventilation in ground-level or below-grade shelters.

properties.name: UKHSA Radon Action Zone: South Wales Coalfield & Taff Gorge
properties.primaryMetric: UKHSA Class: 10–30% Exceedance (>200 Bq/m3 Action Level)
properties.operationalAction: Deep-mined strata & valley fault lines concentrate soil gas in enclosed lower storeys.

properties.name: SSSI: Eryri / Yr Wyddfa & Cwm Idwal National Nature Reserve

properties.name: SSSI: Cors Caron Raised Bog National Nature Reserve (Tregaron)

properties.name: SSSI: Gower Coast (Rhossili to Port Eynon)

properties.operationalAction: FORAGING PROHIBITED: Protected maritime cliff flora and seabird nesting habitat.

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Coed y Brenin & Ganllwyd Oakwoods

properties.name: Ancient Woodland Biome: Wentwood & Wye Gorge Broadleaf

properties.operationalAction: Rich spring wild garlic, elderflower/elderberry, and hazel. Above-ground personal use only; exclude wild fungi.

properties.name: NRW Gauge: River Usk at Brecon Bridge
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 2.30m | Severe Flood: 3.10m | Basin: Usk
properties.operationalAction: Drains northern Bannau Brycheiniog; low town bridges and riverside roads flood rapidly.

properties.name: NRW Gauge: River Usk Tidal Barrier / Newport
properties.primaryMetric: Alert Stage: 6.80m AOD | Severe Surge: 7.50m AOD | Basin: Lower Usk
properties.operationalAction: Extreme Bristol Channel tidal range coincides with Usk spate flow.

properties.name: Traeth Lafan Tidal Stranding Zone (Llanfairfechan)
properties.operationalAction: Extensive mudflats flood rapidly from behind via deep channels. Never cross without tide tables.

properties.name: A5 Ogwen Valley Rockfall & Ice Defile
properties.primaryMetric: STATS19 Cluster | Gale Funnel & Black Ice | W_incident +4.0
properties.operationalAction: Sheer glaciated slabs above single-carriageway; severe crosswinds and winter verglas.

properties.name: A4086 Pen-y-Pass High-Gradient Blackspot
properties.primaryMetric: 1:8 Gradient | Blind Crests & Freezing Fog | W_incident +4.0
properties.operationalAction: Impassable in freezing fog/snow; deploy high-visibility markers if evacuating on foot.

properties.name: A470 Crimea Pass (Blaenau Ffestiniog Summit)
properties.operationalAction: Frequently first North Wales trunk pass closed by snowdrifts and freezing cloud.

properties.name: B4391 Milltir Cerrig Pass (Berwyn Mountains)
properties.primaryMetric: Elevation: 486m | Zero Shelter & Deep Drifts | W_incident +3.5
properties.operationalAction: Remote high-moorland pass with zero cellular signal and rapid whiteout exposure.

properties.name: A487 Newgale Shingle Bank Storm Surge Zone
properties.primaryMetric: Spring Tide + SW Gale Overtopping | W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Storm waves hurl cobbles across A487 coastal causeway; divert inland via Roch/Camrose.

properties.name: Cefn Sidan / Tywi Estuary Quicksand & Tidal Bar
properties.operationalAction: Rapid tidal cut-off across outer sandbanks; keep strictly above high-water dune line.

properties.name: Worm's Head Tidal Causeway (Rhossili)
properties.primaryMetric: Submerged 5 Hours Per Tide Cycle | W_flood +10.0
properties.operationalAction: Rocky causeway floods 2.5h before high water; stranding risk with severe Atlantic swell.

properties.name: A4069 Black Mountain Pass (Hairpin Exposure)
properties.operationalAction: Exposed hairpin mountain road linking Brynaman and Llangadog; hazardous in mist/ice.

properties.name: Sully Island Tidal Causeway (Vale of Glamorgan)
properties.operationalAction: Second-highest tidal range in the world; causeway floods violently on incoming tide.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Port Talbot Margam (PM2.5 / PM10)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | Industrial & Smoke Plume Monitor
properties.operationalAction: Monitors steelworks, M4 corridor, and Afan valley wildfire smoke particulates.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Cardiff Centre (PM2.5 / NO2 / O3)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | Urban Particulate & Inversion Node
properties.operationalAction: Tracks South-East Wales urban air quality and Bristol Channel smoke drift.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Swansea Roadside (PM2.5 / PM10)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | Tawe Valley Inversion Monitor
properties.operationalAction: Monitors particulate trapping during winter anticyclonic temperature inversions.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Wrexham (PM2.5 / PM10)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | North-East Wales Industrial/Moorland Node
properties.operationalAction: Detects Dee Valley inversions and Ruabon/Llantysilio moorland wildfire smoke.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Aston Hill Rural Background (Powys)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | Mid-Wales Elevated Baseline
properties.operationalAction: High-elevation rural particulate and ozone sensor tracking regional plume transport.

properties.name: DEFRA AURN Sensor: Narberth Rural Background (Pembrokeshire)
properties.primaryMetric: ONLINE (UK-AIR AURN) | Live AURN Telemetry | West Wales Maritime Air Monitor
properties.operationalAction: Monitors Atlantic inflow and Milford Haven industrial corridor downwind particulates.
